_note: FROZEN before any Layer-1 expression data were examined. Any change requires a changelog entry in PROTOCOL and a version bump.
_protocol: PROTOCOL_基质刚度与神经病理性痛.md v0.5

layer0.design: genotype x matrix stiffness x replicate

biotype_filter._added_v0_2: R2 - non-coding loci (snoRNA/pseudogene/vault RNA) reached significance through low variance at n=3 and polluted the signature

signature_definition.test: Welch two-sample t-test (stiff vs soft, within genotype)

hippo_stratification._revised_v0_2: R1 - sign-concordance requirement wrongly exiled genes whose response was COMPLETELY abolished by YAP/TAZ knockout (CTGF/CYR61/ANKRD1/AMOTL2 landed in ambiguous)
hippo_stratification.metric: delta = mean(log2FPKM+1, stiff) - mean(log2FPKM+1, soft); r = |delta_knockout| / |delta_WT|

hippo_dependent.rule: r <= 0.5 (sign irrelevant: a fully abolished response has no informative sign)

layer0._canonical_note: Minimal canonical set used only for sensitivity analysis S4. Curated from established YAP/TAZ direct-target reports; frozen a priori.

species_mapping.rule: capitalize-only when symbol is all-uppercase and matches an entry in the mouse table; otherwise leave unchanged
species_mapping.ambiguity_policy: drop conflicting symbols into _UNMAPPED list; no guess-assignment
species_mapping._v0_4_note: R7 - mapping and coverage are two different quantities and are governed separately. mapping_rate = fraction of signature members whose mouse orthologue symbol exists in the annotation (expression-filter independent): a MAPPING FAILURE. coverage_rate = fraction of signature members detected in the target expression matrix after its detection filter: a POWER / cell-type limitation. Only a mapping_rate breach downgrades a primary endpoint; a coverage shortfall is declared in Limitations.
species_mapping.declare_if_coverage_below: power limitation stated in Limitations; effect estimate not interpreted

multiplicity.family: 16 base tests (4 tissues x 2 models x 2 directions) per signature family

overlap_test.method: Fisher exact test on 2x2 table (signature membership x author DEG)

floor_limited.action: flagged in gene-level table; retained in module rank test; removed in sensitivity S2

positive_control._added_v0_4: R9 - a pipeline that only ever yields null results cannot distinguish 'no signal' from 'cannot detect signal'. A pre-specified positive control establishes sensitivity.
positive_control._selection_basis: Regeneration-associated genes (RAGs) and nerve-injury markers consistently reported as up-regulated in DRG neurons after peripheral nerve injury (SNI / axotomy). Selected from the literature ONLY - never from any expression result of this project, which would be circular.
positive_control._direction: expected UP in SNI relative to sham

pass_criterion.statistic: exact permutation P on the saline-arm SNI-vs-sham score difference
pass_criterion.also_report: effect size (difference / pooled SD) for magnitude comparison against the stiffness signatures

positive_control.on_failure: All null conclusions are void. Do not report results from this pipeline; register the diagnosis in protocol v0.5 and declare the unvalidated sensitivity in Limitations.

layer3._added_v0_5: A single-signature null result is one observation. To claim the artefact is a property of the METHOD rather than of this particular signature, independently published mechano/ECM gene sets must be run through the identical machinery and fail the same specificity test.
layer3._frozen: Written before any Layer-3 result was examined.
layer3._selection_basis: Each set was taken from a published, citable source defining ECM / mechanotransduction gene modules. Selection used NO expression result from any layer of this project. Sets were frozen before execution; membership may not be tuned afterwards.
layer3._symbol_space: Human HGNC symbols, mapped to mouse by the same frozen rule as the Layer-0 signature (§4.3).
layer3._primary_purpose: Test tissue SPECIFICITY, not activation: does each set shift more in the target pain tissue (DRG) than in a tissue that cannot plausibly host a stiffness programme (blood)?

G1_core_matrisome.source: Naba A, et al. Matrix Biol 2016 - core matrisome: collagens, proteoglycans, ECM glycoproteins

G2_yap_taz_canonical_targets.source: Dupont S, et al. Nature 2011; Cordenonsi M, et al. Cell 2011; Zhao B, et al. Genes Dev 2008 - direct YAP/TAZ-TEAD targets

G3_mechanosensing_adhesome.source: Coste B, et al. Science 2010; Ranade SS, et al. Nature 2014; Zaidel-Bar R, et al. J Cell Biol 2007 - mechanosensitive channels and the integrin adhesome

G4_actin_rho_rock.source: Ohashi K, et al. J Biochem 2017; Riento K & Ridley AJ, Nat Rev Mol Cell Biol 2003 - actin cytoskeleton and Rho-ROCK contractility

G5_ecm_remodelling_fibrosis.source: Wynn TA, J Pathol 2008; Henderson NC, et al. Nature 2020 - ECM remodelling and fibrotic effectors

layer3.statistic: MRU = median(rank of members) / (n_expressed - 1); ranks 1-based ascending by log2_fc; 0.5 = no shift

null.scheme: size-matched AND baseline-expression-decile-stratified random gene sets, drawn WITHOUT replacement
null.background: expressed genes only (exclude zero/near-zero baseline loci)

specificity_index.interpretation: SI_g < 1 means the set shifts at least as far in blood as in DRG

primary_endpoint.label: L3-generality
primary_endpoint.rule: The null-attribution is a property of the projection METHOD (not of one signature) if >= 4 of the 5 independent gene sets fail tissue specificity (SI_g < 1).
primary_endpoint.report: count and per-set SI_g, plus per-set BH q over the 5 x 8 test family

secondary_endpoints: number of the 40 tests (5 sets x 4 tissues x 2 models) surviving BH at 0.05
directional concordance of the 5 sets within each contrast
per-set effect size |MRU - 0.5| compared against its own matched null

target_journals._verified: Metrics verified online 2026-10-21. JIF = Journal Impact Factor (Web of Science / JCR), NOT CiteScore. SCIE status confirmed from publisher/aggregator listings.
target_journals._excluded: PeerJ family excluded at user's instruction. Scientific Reports excluded: user's reanalysis/retrospective submissions are desk-rejected there repeatedly. PLOS ONE excluded: prior rejection on substantive methodological grounds.

primary.name: GigaScience
primary.jcr_quartile: Q1 (Computer Science Applications) - aggregator-reported, JCR not directly inspected
primary.rationale: Stated criteria are reproducibility, usability and utility; explicitly welcomes data reuse and reanalysis. Best fit for a cross-cohort methodological audit.
